items.description: given a stock record with batch_number and serial_number populated, when the detail API endpoint is called for that record, then the JSON response contains batch_number as a distinct top-level field with its correct value

given a stock record with batch_number and serial_number populated, when the detail API endpoint is called for that record, then the JSON response contains serial_number as a distinct top-level field with its correct value
the stock detail API boundary returns batch_number and serial_number as distinct fields in a JSON response body with no server-rendered HTML (NFR-F6-spa-json-boundary)
navigating to /stock/:id in <App> renders the detail view with batch number in a labeled field carrying the card design-guide class
navigating to /stock/:id in <App> renders the detail view with serial number in a labeled field carrying the card design-guide class
batch number and serial number appear as two distinct separately labeled fields (not merged into one element) in the detail view at /stock/:id
given stock records exist, when the stock list API endpoint is called, then each record in the JSON response contains batch_number as a distinct field
given stock records exist, when the stock list API endpoint is called, then each record in the JSON response contains serial_number as a distinct field
navigating to /stock in <App> renders the list view with each stock record showing a batch number field carrying the stock-table design-guide class
navigating to /stock in <App> renders the list view with each stock record showing a serial number field carrying the stock-table design-guide class
batch number and serial number appear as separate fields per row in the list view at /stock
given a stock record whose batch_number is NULL, when the detail API endpoint is called, then batch_number is present in the JSON response as null rather than absent or causing an error
given a stock record whose serial_number is NULL, when the detail API endpoint is called, then serial_number is present in the JSON response as null rather than absent or causing an error

given a stock record whose batch_number and serial_number are NULL, when the stock list API endpoint is called, then batch_number and serial_number appear as null in the JSON response and the remainder of the record fields are still present
the stock detail API returns batch_number as JSON null (not omitted, not an error) when the column value is NULL on the real branch database
when a stock record has NULL batch_number, the detail view at /stock/:id renders an element with class empty-state instead of an error or broken layout
when a stock record has NULL serial_number, the detail view at /stock/:id renders an element with class empty-state instead of an error or broken layout
when a stock record has NULL batch_number and NULL serial_number, the remaining record fields still display correctly in the detail view at /stock/:id
when stock records have NULL batch_number and NULL serial_number, the list view at /stock renders an element with class empty-state per affected record without a broken layout
given a stock record with split batch and serial fields, when the detail API endpoint is called, the JSON response does not contain an inventory_code field
given stock records exist with split batch and serial fields, when the stock list API endpoint is called, no record in the JSON response contains an inventory_code field
the stock API JSON response for any stock item contains no combined inventory_code field; only the discrete batch_number and serial_number fields appear in the payload
navigating to /stock/:id in <App> finds no element displaying the combined tracking code (inventory_code) in the card
navigating to /stock in <App> finds no element displaying the combined tracking code (inventory_code) in the stock-table
